items.title: Approve the Minutes of the February 25, 2025 Meeting
Appoint Zameel Imaduddin as the District 11 Representative to the Community Advisory Committee

Increase the Amount of the Professional Services Contract with WMH Corporation by $1,500,000, to a Total Amount Not to Exceed $2,650,000 for the Design Phase for the Yerba Buena Island Multi-Use Path Project
Amend the Prop L 5-Year Prioritization Program for Muni Maintenance, Rehabilitation, and Replacement
Allocate $2,000,000 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, for SFMTA: Muni Metro Station Condition Assessmen, Monterey Boulevard Pedestrian Safety Improvement, Embarcadero Mobility Resilience Plan

Award a Two-Year Professional Services Contract, with Options to Extend for Three Additional One-Year Periods, to SPTJ Consulting in an Amount Not to Exceed $600,000 for Computer Network and Maintenance Services
